source.name: Care Quality Commission register bulk files - 'HSCA Active Locations' monthly vintages (Google Drive archive 2011-2026) + 'Deactivated Locations' cumulative register (2026-11-02 edition)
source.api: monthly ODS/XLSX bulk files; the January vintages 2018-2025 are fetched from CQC's public Google Drive archive (year folders 2011-2026, drive folder 1Y6V6r-q2l4lJYKuZL0DXw25VDUTH6L4N, per-file IDs pinned in code/build.py); the label source is https://www.cqc.org.uk/system/files/2026-11/02_November_2026_Deactivated_Locations.ods (anonymous GET, 27,644,723 B); ~118 documented columns on the active-locations vintages
source.accessed: 2026-11-03/04 (the build pins the 2026-11-02 deactivated edition and each vintage's bytes and fails if they change; the register is republished monthly, so the pins are the vintage)
source.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (CQC 'using CQC data' page; in-sheet statement inside the Deactivated Locations file; CQC terms-and-conditions page; evidence recorded in candidates/cqc-care-home-deregistration/record.json license_evidence). Required attribution carries through: 'Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Care Quality Commission (CQC), HSCA Active Locations and Deactivated Locations bulk files.' Derived research dataset - not a CQC product. CQC's in-sheet disclaimer carries through unchanged: CQC is not responsible for subsequent analysis of raw data and must not be quoted as the source of the analysis.

note: One task instance, one artifact. The five shipped files are the cqc-chd-004 worker artifact afe9ee203f302f3c... (gate 1.5.0 on the full artifact, failed_checks empty, exact-byte --accepted on the worker and re-accepted in job cqc-chd-baseline-001); the package's code/ carries the construction script, the references implementation, the runner-workdir materializer and the gate, baseline/ the runner-contract baseline. The holdout ships as an asset like the other splits; it is not copied into any runner workdir and was never evaluated. The prediction instant is the vintage production instant T (period_end, an administrative register snapshot; kind=period_end with 0-day lag is admissible because the vintage IS the register state at its production instant, as-of asserted in-build: 0/14,765 eval rows carry a rating publication date after T). Identity ships as per-instant pseudonyms (the missing-successor P0 design), so no prior-instant label is linkable - for solvers too; there is NO persistence reference by design and cross-row probes measured eval/holdout successor coverage 0. Training-label timing is declared UNVERIFIED (no full-row availability ledger for the 2011-2026 Drive archive) and the evaluation contract is retrospective research only. Recorded finding carried in measurements.json, RELEASE_NOTES.md and VERIFICATION.md: the stock runner baseline (eval AUC 0.5659 from both runner implementations) trails the strongest reference rating_x_beds_rate 0.5871 on the identical 14,765 eval rows (observed gap 0.0212; a recorded defect for the stock runner, not a no-headroom verdict - the model beats every one-line prior, and the reference reads only shipped at-T columns) - no figure may be quoted without that comparison beside it. The target is the register event (deregistration), which CQC's own file note says can include services continuing under a new registration; the framing limitation is stated in every document.
